data.name: Firman
data.gender_notes: Firman is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'fero' meaning to carry or bear, Firman is a name of Latin origin that has come to mean 'man' or 'ruler'. This name was popular among the early Christians and was borne by several saints. The name Firman carries the meaning “Man, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Firman usually hope their child will grow to embody man, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing strength and leadership.
data.etymology: Firman belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man, ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Firman total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: פִּירְמָן
in_hebrew.meaning: בן המסמך, ילד האמת, ילד מפורש
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פִּירְמָן (פִּירְמָן) - בן המסמך, ילד האמת. השם יוצא מהביטאון 'firman', שמקורו בעברית 'פִּרְמָן', שמשמעו 'מסמך, תוכנית'. בעקבות זה, המשמעות של פִּירְמָן היא 'ילד האמת, ילד התוכנית'. כאשר נוסף לו הקידומת 'בן', המשמעות הכוללת של פִּירְמָן היא 'בן המסמך, ילד האמת'. פִּירְמָן יכול להיות נקרא גם 'בן האמת, ילד האמת' אך ללא קידומת 'בן'. השם פִּירְמָן מזוהה גם כ'פִּירְמָן (Firman)', שהוא שם המשפחה של חבר הפרלמנט הבריטי אלברט פִּירְמָן .

in_greek.name: Φίρμαν
in_greek.meaning: γιός της αλήθειας, γιος του βεληνεκτού
in_greek.long_meaning: Φίρμαν (Φίρμαν) - γιος της αλήθειας, γιος του βεληνεκτού. Το όνομα προέρχεται από το βεληνεκτό Φίρμαν, που σημαίνει 'βεληνεκτό'. Η σημασία του Φίρμαν είναι 'γιος της αλήθειας, γιος του βεληνεκτού'. Όταν προστίθεται το προθεματικό 'γιος', η καθαρή σημασία του Φίρμαν είναι 'γιος της αλήθειας, γιος του βεληνεκτού'. Ο Φίρμαν μπορεί να ονομαστεί επίσης 'γιος της αλήθειας, γιος του βεληνεκτού' χωρίς το προθεματικό 'γιος'. Το όνομα Φίρμαν σχετίζεται επίσης με το 'Φίρμαν (Firman)', το επώνυμο του βρετανικού βουλευτή Άλμπερτ Φίρμαν.

in_latin.name: Firman
in_latin.long_meaning: Firman - veritas, veritas manifesta, veritas revelata. Nomen Firman originem habet ab anglice 'firman', quod significat 'mandatum, planus'. Itaque significatio Firman est 'veritas manifesta, veritas revelata'. Cum adicetur prae-fixum 'filius', significatio completa Firman est 'filius veritatis, veritas manifesta'. Firman potest nominari etiam 'filius veritatis, veritas revelata' abs prae-fixo 'filius'. Nomen Firman connectum est etiam cum 'Firman (Firman)', nomine familiae Britannici parliamentarii Alberti Firman.

in_english.name: Firman
in_english.meaning: son of the truth, son of the manifest truth
in_english.long_meaning: Firman - son of the truth, son of the manifest truth. The name Firman originates from the English word 'firman', which means 'mandate, plan'. Thus, the meaning of Firman is 'son of the truth, son of the manifest truth'. When the prefix 'son of' is added, the complete meaning of Firman is 'son of the truth, son of the manifest truth'. Firman can also be named 'son of the truth, son of the manifest truth' without the prefix 'son of'. The name Firman is connected with 'Firman (Firman)', the surname of British parliamentarian Albert Firman. The name Firman is derived from the concept of firman in Islamic tradition, which represents the divine decree or mandate. In a broader sense, Firman can be interpreted as 'son of the divine will, son of the divine command'. In the context of Christian tradition, Firman can be seen as a symbol of God's truth and revelation. As a given name, Firman conveys the importance of truth and integrity. It is a unique and meaningful name that reflects the values of honesty and authenticity.
